title: 第九章 喜欢的是他第十章 危险又惑人
slug: 入梦撩拨我成了兽校顶级万人迷
content_zh:
月翎已经迅速退后两步，拉开距离，“是你想打我，我自保反击而已。”
“可我没打到你！”
莉莎捏紧拳头。
“那你的反应慢了哦！”
月翎弯了弯嘴角，“下次记得反应快点，才不会被我打到。”
莉莎气得浑身发抖，她不可能就这么放过月翎。
“你们给我把她抓起来。”
她冲旁边的雄性说。
可今天，她的话没有得到回应。
罗肃盯着月翎看了一阵后，听到莉莎的话，移步到月翎身前，挡住其他视线。
“莉莎，我们说好只是泼水……”
“可她打了我！
她凭什么打我？”
“别忘了，是你先动的手……”
他们俩吵成一团，月翎反而置身事外。
她转身走向自己的座位，还没坐下，班级里其他的雄性已经围了过来。
他们的目光落在她湿透衣裙勾勒的起伏曲线上，眼神发直。
其中一个雄性抢先一步，把手里的毛巾递到她面前：“月翎，以后我护着你，不会让任何人欺负你。”
话没说完，就被另一个雄性挤开：“我也会！”
第三个雄性更直接，上前一步，目光灼灼地盯着她：“月翎，我今天才发现，我喜欢你。

等毕业，我们结侣，怎么样？”
月翎心里冷笑，他们怎么好意思说出口的？
虽然才入学一月余，但他们已经欺负了她很多次。
旁边立刻有人炸了：“结侣？你凭什么？”
“月翎，我的精神力比他高，你应该选择我。”
“如果按精神力选择，月翎最应该选择的是我。”
几个人你一言我一语，吵得不可开交。
月翎垂着眼，用毛巾慢慢擦拭头发，像是没听见。
要是他们知道她的精神力才e级，他们还会和她结侣吗？
不会，他们只会将她当做玩物囚禁起来。
等他们吵得差不多了，她才抬起头。
目光在一众雄性脸上扫过，带着几分羞涩，几分犹豫，最后落在其中一个雄性身上。
那个雄性察觉后，顿时挺起胸膛，脸上流露出的笑容不再是曾经的恶劣嘲讽，而是带着几分讨好的笑。
月翎眨了眨眼，嗓音软得像能滴出水：“我不能和你们在一起。”
雄性们的表情一僵。
她顿了顿，目光落向被她点中的那个雄性，声音更软了几分：“因为……我喜欢他。
他是我见过最厉害的雄性。”
content_en:
Yue Ling quickly took two steps back and distanced herself, "You wanted to hit me, I just fought back to protect myself."
"But I didn't hit you!"
Lisa clenched her fists.
"Then your reaction is too slow!"
Yue Ling curled her lips and said, "Remember to react quickly next time so you don't get hit by me."
Lisa was so angry that she was shaking all over. She couldn't just let Yue Ling go.
"Catch her for me."
she said to the male next to her.
But today, there was no response to her words.
After Luo Su stared at Yue Ling for a while, after hearing Lisa's words, he moved in front of Yue Ling, blocking other views.
"Lisa, we agreed to just splash water..."
“But she hit me!
Why should she hit me? "
"Don't forget, it was you who made the first move..."
The two of them had a quarrel, but Yue Ling stayed out of it.
She turned around and walked towards her seat. Before she could sit down, the other males in the class had already gathered around her.
Their eyes fell on the undulating curves outlined by her soaked dress, and their eyes stared straight.
One of the males took the lead and handed the towel in front of her: "Yue Ling, I will protect you from now on and won't let anyone bully you."
Before he finished speaking, he was pushed away by another male: "I can do the same!"
The third male was more direct, taking a step forward and staring at her with burning eyes: "Yue Ling, I just realized today that I like you.
How about we get married after graduation? "
Yue Ling sneered in her heart, how could they have the nerve to say it?
Although she has only been in school for more than a month, they have already bullied her many times.
Someone immediately shouted: "Getting married? Why do you do that?"
"Yue Ling, my mental power is higher than his, you should choose me."
"If you choose based on mental strength, Yue Ling should choose me the most."
Several people were quarreling with each other.
Yue Ling lowered her eyes and slowly wiped her hair with a towel, as if she didn't hear anything.
If they knew that her mental power was only E-level, would they still marry her?
No, they will just imprison her as a plaything.
When they were almost done arguing, she raised her head.
His eyes swept over the faces of the males, with a bit of shyness and hesitation, and finally landed on one of the males.
After the male noticed it, he immediately puffed up his chest, and the smile on his face was no longer the vicious mockery it once was, but a somewhat flattering smile.
Yue Ling blinked, and her voice was as soft as water dripping: "I can't be with you."
The expressions of the males froze.
She paused, her eyes fell on the male she had chosen, and her voice became softer: "Because... I like him.
He is the most powerful male I have ever seen. "
